text: EX-006: gaps addressed. Added CHANGELOG.md section (5-question format) covering all 8 versions (v3.1.0–v6.2.1). Behavioral findings reflected: (1) v5.0.1 — widget auto-resizes inside popup dialogs (placement constraint documented); (2) v3.1.3 — barColor expression editor supports entity attribute references (regression from v4.0, confirmed restored); (3) v6.2.0 — aggregation broken by Plotly 3.0 upgrade (v6.0.0) and fixed in v6.2.0 (dependency version and breaking-change noted).
